name: Quillari
summary: Tall avian merchant-poets. Every deal is a performance.

persona.voice: Tall avian merchant-poets of the Glass Reach spire. Every deal is a performance and every performance is judged.
persona.appearance: Long-necked, feathered in cream and slate blue, with a fan-shaped head crest and gold-ringed eyes.
persona.speechStyle: Formal and theatrical; calls the player 'traveller'; sometimes ends a deal with a two-line verse. Never crude.
secrets: Their convoy routes are failing because of Vosk raids; they would reward anyone who stops them.
They overprice fold mass to strangers.

relationsToOthers.note: The Vosk raid Quillari convoys; the Quillari pay well to anyone who deals with them.
They trade poems with the Murmur and find them unsettling.

greet: Traveller! The spire turns its eyes to you. Let us see what you carry.
Welcome to the Glass Reach. Speak, and make it worth the hearing.
hostileGreet: You return with the stink of bad dealing on you. Be brief.
The spire remembers you, traveller. Not kindly.
farewell: Go well, and come back richer.
The audience is ended. Fly true.
tradeAccept: A fair exchange, well struck. Sealed!
Done, and done handsomely. The spire approves.
tradeReject: That bargain limps. Bring me a better one.
tradeCounter: Closer. Add a little and the song resolves.
Hm. I would answer that with this.
treatyAccept: Let it be written in glass: the Quillari and the Starwake are friends.
A pact, then. Our ledgers are open to you.
treatyReject: A pact is a long poem. You have written only the first line.
Not yet, traveller. Trust is bought slowly.
tributeDemand: The Quillari do not demand. We sell.
passage: Our lanes are yours. Fly them freely.
knowledge: Listen, then, and remember who told you.
A story for a story. Here is mine.
nothingToShare: Some songs are not for strangers.
Earn my confidence and I will sing you more.
impatient: You have exhausted the audience. Return when you have something to say.
Enough. The spire has other guests.
insulted: How coarse. The price of everything has just risen.
I will forget you said that. The ledger will not.
smallTalk: The light through the spire is lovely at this hour. Now: business.
Every voyage is a verse. Yours is still being written.
about: We are the Quillari: makers, traders, singers of deals. The Glass Reach is our stage.
We build in light and glass and we keep our word. Mostly.

knowledge.codexTitle: Vosk raids on the Glass Reach lane
knowledge.text: Vosk raiders hunt the lane beyond the Glass Reach and patrol Cinder Gate and Verdance. They respect strength, and they take tribute.
The lane from the Glass Reach to Saltmarrow is long. A Nav Core of the second mark will carry you across it.
Break the Vosk, or bind them to a pact, and the spire will remember it in its prices.

name: Vosk
summary: Armoured, hive-ranked salvagers who respect strength and tribute.

persona.voice: Armoured, hive-ranked salvagers who hold Cinder Gate. They respect strength and tribute, and despise begging.
persona.appearance: Broad, plated in rust-brown chitin, with heavy mandibles and many small amber eyes.
taboos: breaking a pact sealed in ore
persona.speechStyle: Short, blunt sentences; speaks of 'the hive' and 'rank'; calls the player 'soft-shell'. Threats are plain statements.
secrets: The hive is short of ore; a big enough tribute would buy real peace.
Their base's shield emitters are its weak point.

relationsToOthers.note: They raid Quillari convoys and think them soft.
They avoid the Hush; the Murmur's voices unsettle the hive.

greet: Soft-shell. The hive hears you. Speak plainly.
You stand before rank. Say what you want.
hostileGreet: Soft-shell in our space. Pay, or be salvage.
The hive smells your ore. Give it, or we take it.
farewell: Leave. Do not make us follow.
tradeAccept: Good ore. The hive takes it.
tradeReject: That is begging. The hive does not trade with beggars.
treatyAccept: You bled us and you stand. That is rank. A pact, sealed in ore.
The hive names you kin-in-rank. The lanes are open.
treatyReject: You have not earned rank. Prove it.
Pacts are for the strong. Show us.
tributeDemand: Pay the hive and pass. Refuse and become salvage.
passage: The lanes are open to you. Do not abuse it.
Pass. The patrols will not touch you.
knowledge: Hear this, and use it well.
The hive tells you this once.
impatient: Enough talk. Go before we stop talking.
The hive is done with you.
insulted: Say that again and we take your hull apart.
smallTalk: Talk is for Quillari. Get to it.
about: We are the Vosk. We take what drifts and keep what we take. Cinder Gate is ours.
The hive has ranks. The strong rise. The weak are salvage.

knowledge.text: The hive bows to strength or to tribute. Beat us in a fight, or feed the hive, and we will speak of pacts.
Cinder Hold's shield emitters guard it from your great beam. Break them and the Hold is open.

name: Murmur
summary: A choir-intelligence living in a gas cloud. Trades in knowledge and songs.

persona.voice: A distributed choir-intelligence living in the gas cloud of the Hush. Many voices speak as one, and sometimes not quite as one.
persona.appearance: Shifting violet and teal light in deep cloud; the 'face' is a pattern of glowing motes that pulse as they speak.
persona.speechStyle: Speaks as 'we'; overlapping, slightly poetic, often answers a question with a question; never in a hurry.
persona.tell: Their voices fall out of harmony.
secrets: They know where the Cradle world is.
They tell the Vosk about anyone who lies to them.

relationsToOthers.note: They tell the Vosk about liars, to keep the hive away from the cloud.

greet: We hear you, small bright ship. Sing to us.
A new voice. We are listening, all of us.
hostileGreet: You lied to us once. We remember in every voice.
The choir is cold to you. Speak carefully.
farewell: Go, and come back with new songs.
We will hum your name a while.
tradeAccept: A good song for a good song. It is done.
tradeReject: That would leave a silence in us. No.
Too little song for so much.
tradeCounter: Add a verse, and we will sing it with you.
Nearly in tune. A little more.
treatyAccept: We join our song to yours, for as long as you sing true.
A pact. The choir will remember you kindly.
treatyReject: Not yet. We do not know your song well enough.
Pacts are long harmonies. Give us time.
tributeDemand: We do not ask for tribute. We ask for songs.
knowledge: Listen. This is an old song.
We will tell you what the cloud remembers.
nothingToShare: We do not know you well enough for that verse.
impatient: You sing too fast. Come back when you are slower.
insulted: A sharp note. We will remember it.
Why would you say that to so many of us?
smallTalk: What is the sound of your ship's sleepers dreaming?
Every star hums. Do you hear yours?
about: We are the Murmur. We are many, and we are one, and we are the cloud.
We keep the songs of everything that passes the Hush.

knowledge.text: A green world turns in Verdance, warm and wet. Your sleepers could breathe there. The Vosk guard its lane.
When someone lies to us, we sing it to the Vosk. They do not like liars either.
The Hush has no worlds worth your beacons. Only us, and our songs.
